name: Heman
title: The King's Seer and Leader of Praise
summary: Heman was a Levite from the descendants of Korah and one of the three main singers appointed by King David to lead worship in the tabernacle. He was called 'the king's seer' and was known for his wisdom. He is also traditionally associated with Psalm 88 and was the father of fourteen sons and three daughters.

keyEvents.title: Appointed as Music Leader by David
keyEvents.description: King David appointed Heman along with Asaph and Jeduthun to lead the worship and music ministry at the Lord's tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: The King's Seer
keyEvents.description: Heman was recognized as the king's seer in God's word, a prestigious position that testifies to his spiritual authority and prophetic gift.

keyEvents.title: Heman's Fourteen Sons and Three Daughters
keyEvents.description: God blessed Heman with fourteen sons and three daughters. All the sons served under their father's leadership in the musical service of the temple.

keyEvents.title: Organization of the Music Departments
keyEvents.description: Heman and his sons were assigned to service groups by lot, together with the sons of Asaph and Jeduthun for temple service, totaling 24 divisions.

keyEvents.title: Psalm 88 – Heman's Prayer in Distress
keyEvents.description: Psalm 88 is attributed to the Ezrahite Heman and is one of the darkest lament psalms in the Bible, a deep prayer from a man in great suffering who still turns to God.

keyEvents.title: Heman's Wisdom Compared with Solomon's
keyEvents.description: Heman is mentioned as one of the famous wise men, but Solomon's wisdom surpassed his. This shows that Heman was recognized for his great wisdom in Israel.
